title: Chen's generalized partition inequality
statement:
Let $p(n)$ denote the classical partition function, and let $a>b$ be integers such that $an,bn\in\mathbb{N}$. **Chen's conjecture.** For all $a>b$, one has

$$
p^2(an)-p(an-bn)p(an+bn)>0.
$$

This is an analogue of inequalities studied for the classical partition function; its status is not resolved in the supplied source context.
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2013–2022). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1309.6302](https://arxiv.org/abs/1309.6302).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.04752

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2022).
source_name: Krystian Gajdzica, “Log-concavity of the restricted partition function p_A(n,k) and the new Bessenrodt-Ono type inequality”, arXiv:2206.04752 (2022).
